title: Sliding Fee Discount Application
about: Household size and income for the clinic's sliding fee discount, the same facts UDS Table 4 reports by poverty level.

source.name: HRSA Health Center Program Compliance Manual, chapter 9 (Sliding Fee Discount Program)

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: {facility.name} offers discounts based on household size and income. What you write here is kept private. We use it to decide your discount, and, without your name, in reports the clinic must make.
List everyone in your household: you, your spouse or partner, and anyone you support or who supports you.

blocks.label: Proof of income attached, for each person with income
items: Social Security, disability or pension letter
No proof available: I declare my income above is correct
No income (write below how you are supported)

blocks.label: If you have no income, how are you supported?

blocks.text: I certify that the information above is true and complete. I will tell the clinic if my household size or income changes. I understand that a discount given on false information may be withdrawn.
